bgremove.mdd: Let me lift the background off.
bgremove.opt.despill: Remove background colour left on the edge
bgremove.opt.pick: Click the background to pick it
bgremove.status.badImage: Could not read that as an image
bgremove.status.nothing: Nothing was removed. loosen the threshold or click the background to pick it
bgremove.status.tooMuch: Removed {n}%. that is too loose, lower the threshold
bgremove.note.limits: Colour mode removes flat or near-flat backgrounds (ID photos, product shots, scans). it only eats colour connected from the edges, so an inner area matching the background stays. For shapes, use "cut out by shape" above. the model is downloaded only then.
bgremove.ai.title: Cut out by shape (downloaded once, instant after that)
bgremove.ai.hint: Cuts by shape, not by colour. Your photo never leaves the device. only the model is downloaded.
bgremove.ai.noncommercial: The anything model is non-commercial. for commercial work use the person model or the colour mode.
bgremove.ai.empty: Found nothing. try the other model, or remove by colour
bgremove.ai.full: Nothing was removed. the whole photo read as the subject
bgremove.ai.backToColor: Back to removing by colour (press the button again for shape)
